domains.name: Exhibition Interpretation Operations
domains.scope: Reconcile exhibition interpretation, visitor-facing delivery and loan-return records while separating editorial proposals from observed installation and custody evidence.

skills.name: exhibit-label-claim-revision-propagation
skills.description: Trace a changed exhibit claim into every affected label and derivative when new source evidence alters published interpretation.

skills.name: multilingual-exhibit-panel-parity
skills.description: Plan equivalent interpretive content and reading paths across language versions when exhibit panels face unequal text lengths and space constraints.

skills.name: exhibit-object-label-placement-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile exhibit objects, label identities and installed positions when a display move or rehang could attach accurate text to the wrong object.

skills.name: exhibit-kiosk-visitor-session-reset-review
skills.description: Specify and inspect visible reset behavior for shared exhibit kiosks when abandoned or completed interactions could leave confusing state for the next visitor.

skills.name: exhibit-alternate-route-interpretation-parity
skills.description: Compare the interpretive sequence available on different exhibit routes when visitors bypass a room, medium or physical feature.

skills.name: exhibit-loan-return-evidence-dossier
skills.description: Assemble a loan-return dossier linking exhibited objects, associated components, packing records, condition observations and custody acknowledgments when an exhibition closes.
